describe: make the LED blink faster or slower
guide: The blink is ON_SECONDS and OFF_SECONDS at the top of src/main.py. Smaller numbers blink faster.
report: The LED is on for $on s and off for $off s now -- it was $old_on and $old_off.
ON_SECONDS is $on and OFF_SECONDS is $off now, from $old_on and $old_off.
It blinks $on s on and $off s off now.
teach: time.sleep waits that many seconds, so the two numbers are how long the LED stays on and off.
